name: Neural Logistics Interface
shortDescription: Your nervous system is linked directly to your ship, fleet, and TriPad, accelerating tactical coordination and logistical planning. The constant neural load reduces peak combat endurance.
longDescription: The Neural Logistics Interface establishes a permanent connection between your nervous system, your TriPad, and nearby fleet systems. Orders, navigational data, and tactical information are exchanged almost instantaneously, improving battlefield coordination and route planning through hazardous terrain. The interface continuously processes large amounts of sensory information, reducing the time required to react to changing situations. The additional neural workload, however, places considerable strain on the brain during prolonged operations. As a result, peak performance time is reduced.

name: Reflex Accelerator
shortDescription: Cybernetic augmentation of the peripheral nervous system dramatically improves reflexes and seamlessly integrates your TriPad into your sensory perception. The resulting neural overload limits sustained combat performance.
longDescription: The Reflex Accelerator replaces sections of the peripheral nervous system with high-speed cybernetic pathways linked directly to your TriPad. Sensor data, weapon telemetry, and ship system diagnostics are processed almost as quickly as natural reflexes, greatly improving target acquisition and reaction times. The augmentation enables exceptionally precise control during combat, but operates near the limits of human neurological tolerance. Extended engagements frequently result in sensory overload, involuntary muscle fatigue, and degraded cognitive performance. Consequently, maximum combat readiness is reduced.

name: Biogenesis
shortDescription: Your blood has been replaced with Ichorene and your body reinforced with Myosynth tissue, creating a permanent biological link with your TriPad. The augmentation often induces brief trance-like states but greatly enhances endurance.
longDescription: The Biogenesis procedure replaces your circulatory system with Ichorene while integrating limited Myosynth structures throughout your body. Rather than relying on conventional electronics, your TriPad communicates through a living biological interface that feels less like operating a device and more like sensing another part of your own body. Users frequently report brief trance-like episodes during periods of low activity, though no lasting physiological side effects have been documented. The augmentation significantly improves physical endurance and resistance to prolonged combat fatigue, increasing peak performance time.
